subject.title: Add auth sync command or auto-sync for API key rotation across agents

question: Should OpenClaw resolve API-key rotation shadowing with an operator-controlled auth repair/warning flow, automatic cross-agent sync, or runtime fallback from stale profiles to updated env/config credentials?
rationale: All viable fixes change credential propagation, provider precedence, or failure recovery semantics across agent stores, and repository policy treats those as security- and compatibility-sensitive product decisions.

options.title: Operator-controlled repair and warnings
options.body: Add an explicit CLI/doctor/status path that detects shadowed provider credentials and updates canonical SQLite auth stores only when the user asks for the repair.

options.title: Automatic sync on config change/reload
options.body: Make config/env key updates propagate to matching agent auth stores automatically, accepting the wider implicit credential-copying behavior after security review.

options.title: Runtime fallback after auth failure
options.body: Try env/config credentials after a stored profile fails, accepting a precedence change that could mask stale state and alter provider failover behavior.

recommendation.title: Operator-controlled repair and warnings
recommendation.body: Add an explicit CLI/doctor/status path that detects shadowed provider credentials and updates canonical SQLite auth stores only when the user asks for the repair.

likelyOwner.reason: The most central recent history for auth read-through and egress-time credential injection is in the files that would define the permanent precedence semantics.
